title: Qwen 2.5 — CPU & RAM Execution Requirements
notes: RAM values include: Q4-quantised model weights + KV cache + OS/runtime overhead. KV cache scales with context length. CPU speed (tps) measured on Ryzen 5 5600 using llama.cpp with the recommended thread count. Peak RAM (typical) = 4 K context. Peak RAM (max ctx) = full context window.

models.name: Qwen2.5-0.5B
models.notes: Runs on a Raspberry Pi 4 or any modern laptop.

models.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B
models.notes: Fits in 2 GB RAM; comfortable on entry-level laptops.

models.name: Qwen2.5-3B
models.notes: Best MMLU/RAM ratio. Needs 4 GB system RAM minimum.

models.name: Qwen2.5-7B
models.notes: Needs 8 GB system RAM for typical use; 16 GB for full 128K context.

models.name: Qwen2.5-14B
models.notes: Needs 16 GB RAM. GPU with 12 GB VRAM allows full offload.

models.name: Qwen2.5-72B
models.notes: Requires 64 GB RAM minimum. Multi-GPU or dual-socket recommended.

ram_components_explained.ram_model_q4: Q4-quantised weight tensors loaded into RAM (GB)
ram_components_explained.ram_kv_cache_4k: Key-Value cache for a 4 K token context (GB)
ram_components_explained.ram_kv_cache_max: Key-Value cache at maximum supported context (GB)
ram_components_explained.ram_os_overhead: OS, Python runtime, allocator, and misc buffers (GB)
ram_components_explained.peak_ram_typical: Total peak RAM during typical 4 K context chat (GB)
ram_components_explained.peak_ram_max_ctx: Total peak RAM at full context window (GB)
